claims.claim: Short silent videos of what's new in Medipyxis, each with a description of what's on screen, why it matters, and a text description of the video.

Medipyxis runs wound care rounding at skilled nursing and assisted living facilities from start to finish: set up the facility as a building, book every resident's visit for the day, see each resident, bill the visit with the facility on the claim, and send the facility its signed notes. (5 short videos)

claims.claim: Practice Onboarding imports your patient records from your old EHR system, one spreadsheet (CSV file) at a time: patients first, then insurance, medications, allergies, conditions, emergency contacts, wounds and past visits. You see every row before it is saved, rows with problems are left out with a reason, and a results file tells you exactly what was imported.

claims.claim: Eleven short videos walk through Medipyxis: finding your way around, HR and staff onboarding, the referral CRM, adding a patient, assigning and booking them, documenting and signing the visit, orders and DME, Fleet Calendar, the Oversight Cockpit and Team Chat. Each video has on-screen captions and a full text transcript below it.
